benchmark_rules: Benchmark across multiple leaders, products, disciplines and research sources where relevant
Separate principle from style — learn why a pattern succeeds before borrowing its shape
Never flatten a distinctive, successful NayaNET experience merely to match prevailing SaaS conventions
Search for combinations that no single benchmark possesses: e.g. Oura-level distillation + Linear-level focus + Apple-level physicality + NayaNET-level intelligence/provenance/continuity
Generate at least one credible beyond-benchmark alternative when the problem is material and the space is underdetermined
Compare candidates against the same human-outcome gates plus NayaNET truth, authority, continuity and intelligence requirements
Treat '10x better' as ambition toward step-change human value; quantify only when a real metric supports the factor
Promote a new design lesson only after evidence shows improved human outcome without regressing critical dimensions
cold_designer_acceptance_chain: leave a better design starting point
design_learning_rule: Pattern promotion requires scope, human outcome, visual evidence, measured/behavioral gain, accessibility gain, performance gain without experience regression, accepted visual comparison and successful reuse; record provenance, applicability, evidence, contradictions and supersession. AI-builder preference alone never creates universal law.
evidence_boundary: The 2026-10-02 adoption is based on a distilled benchmark corpus of public material; it is not a claim that every referenced book was ingested cover-to-cover or that any external source is canonical project authority. NayaPOWER governance, current project contracts, current human direction and verified project outcomes remain authoritative.
human_experience_laws: DIRECT MANIPULATION WHEN IT CLARIFIES CAUSALITY
DESIGN MUST LEARN FROM HUMAN OUTCOMES
mission: Design intelligence is a first-class Naya capability: a living, coherent, high-trust product experience that compounds design intelligence through evidence — not generic dashboards, isolated pages or taste-only decoration.
purpose: The canonical Naya Design Intelligence Standard: the design mission, 16 core design laws, quality gates, the design-learning rule, the finding rule, elite-builder default outputs, the reject list, cold-designer acceptance, the adopted human-centered interaction science (including the ten human-experience laws and cognitive ergonomics checks), and the benchmark-to-beyond law.
standing_finding_rule_as_written: If any Naya/agent sees something materially not-right, the observation goes to Issue #554 with evidence (broken/stale/contradictory state, missing proof, unsafe behavior, quality regression, architectural divergence, costly-later defects). Do not silently hide it; do not broaden an unrelated implementation to fix it; record, classify, route, then fix under applicable authority.
success_condition: MAXIMUM RESPONSIBLE HUMAN VALUE WITH MINIMUM NECESSARY COGNITIVE BURDEN — expressed through an interface that is clear, useful, beautiful, trustworthy, alive, accessible, fast and unmistakably Naya.
title: NAYA DESIGN INTELLIGENCE STANDARD V1
